items.crucible: 0.1 mm thick Al2O3 disc, with a NiCr thin film heater deposited on the underside
items.instrument: high-precision adiabatic calorimeter with two isothermal shields
items.quote: The low-temperature specific heat was determined using the high-precision adiabatic calorimeter with two isothermal shields [30, 31]. The sample holder was a 0.1 mm thick Al2O3 disc, with a NiCr thin film heater deposited on the underside. A calibrated platinum resistance thermometer was employed. The temperature of the isothermal shields was controlled to better than 5 mK. The 50-300 mg samples were cemented to the sample holder using a weighed amount of Apiezon-N grease. The post-heating temperature drift curve was fitted by an exponential function. The experimental errors were estimated to be below 1%.
